title: Milkable Squids
body:
Ever looked at a squid and thought, 'Wow, I really wish I could milk that?' Well, now you can! This revolutionary plugin does exactly what it says on the tin: Allows you to milk squids. That's it. That's the plugin. It adds the groundbreaking ability to milk squids. Why would you want this? Frankly, who wouldn’t?

Features:

    Squid milking.
    Endless possibilities (probably).

Why download it? Because you can. And sometimes, that's all that matters.
